Lara H: We need a no-friction partner SEV path that works for cloud marketplace, device partners, and SIs. quick: one shared public lane + auto warroom for deep triage.
Tom W: +1. public lane = #p-<vendor>-sev (short). warroom spun by ops-bot using /sev start. keep the public lane as the timeline and avoid forking into DMs.
Clara J: Proposed tiny checklist to paste in public lane when raising: severity, one-line impact, PD link, partner owner handle, RDW oncall handle, and warroom link. example to copy/paste below.
ops-bot: (bot) will respond to `/sev start vendor=atlas` by creating warroom, PD stub, and setting channel topic with owner tags. prototype endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.dev/partner-sev-lite
Tom W: Ack expectations: partner L1 5m for sev-1, RDW takes over at 10m if no partner ack. document forced takeover rules in runbook so everyone knows.
Lara H: Archive rule: keep the public lane active for 6 days, then write a 2-line incident summary and move messages to #partner-archive. helps partners search without noisy channels.
Clara J: If data sensitivity or compliance hit, call sec/legal privately, then redact sensitive bits before posting into the public lane.
Lara H: I'll author a one-page runbook and a copyable paste template. Tom will own ops-bot work, Clara will verify legal/contract constraints. target: PR by EOD tomorrow.
Tom W: Filing OPS-8001 for webhook + bot flow. ops-bot: please create the stub PR when Lara uploads the runbook.
ops-bot: (bot) OPS-8001 created. will post PR stub on request.
